description: This Java source file implements the AsyncCommandClient interface for sending asynchronous command messages in a system that uses messaging via Proton and Vert.x. It defines the AsyncCommandClientImpl class, which manages message creation, target address determination, and connection handling for device commands within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of AsyncCommandClient for asynchronous device command messaging, managing message creation, target address formation, and connection setup.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Overrides stateful message sending, sends a message and waits for its outcome.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a tracing span for outgoing messages, requires tracer configuration.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null; not used for device address resolution in this implementation.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string for command requests as defined in CommandConstants.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address URL for a device command based on tenantId and deviceId.

methods.name: getLinkTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the link target address URL for establishing the sender link based on tenantId.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the delivery outcome.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous command message to a device, setting relevant message headers and reply-to addresses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AsyncCommandClientImpl instance connected to Hono, scoped to a specific tenant and device with a link close hook.
